title: In-Progress Phase Field — Advisory-Noise Suppressor After v0.8.3
summary: The `**In-progress phase:**` field's role is advisory-noise suppression, not phase-manifest-check enforcement; the field is optional and its absence does not produce a correctness failure. Introduced in v0.8.2 as a load-bearing predicate preventing a Stop-hook blocking loop, the field is obsolete in that role after ADR-088's v0.8.3 advisory demotion (the manifest check can no longer block, so it cannot cascade); its remaining function is to suppress the repeated missing-artifacts advisory during expected mid-phase work. Set at phase entry and removed at phase-exit readiness by the orchestrator, per the existing per-entry header field lifecycle.
workflow_point: cycle-status.md active entry — In-progress phase field, read at each Stop event
mechanism: advisory-noise suppression: suppresses the repeated per-phase manifest advisory during expected mid-phase work; optional, not correctness-critical

links.note: the In-progress phase field's suppression is scoped to the per-phase manifest advisory only; the compound-check fabrication detection (ADR-064, as updated by ADR-088) is unaffected
the gate-reflection-note check (ADR-066, conditioned on the separate In-progress gate field) is unaffected by this field's suppression scope
documents the field's v0.8.2 to v0.8.3 role shift promptly to avoid the silent-drift failure mode ADR-074's body-immutability rule addresses

ADR-088's advisory demotion of the phase-manifest check makes the field's original v0.8.2 load-bearing blocking-loop-prevention role obsolete, motivating this ADR's role-shift to advisory-noise suppressor
